status: proposed before any real mixed experiment; no performance result
objective: IQ2 up mixed-cache benefit and total-time stability with unchanged CPU libraries
Cplan_scope: final-plan membership diagnostic using fixed synthetic routes; not typical traffic
frozen_actual_modes: all 0; logical O/S retained for placebo
timing: CLOCK_MONOTONIC begin/end around synchronous ggml_backend_graph_compute only; full operator including graph planning
raw_policy: Keep all chunks and all failures; buffer records and serialize after measurements; no outlier exclusion
saved_outputs: mode0 expected for 8 groups per case; each timed chunk final output checked in memory; all 32 intermediate outputs are not captured
reference_scope: same cache membership and same input/routes; expected bytes checked across all 8 processes

statistics.primary: within E: O/S per-block paired ratios and ratio of total times; 4 process summaries retained
statistics.cross: F has 4 arms vs E logical O or S has 2; normalize F total by 2 for equal work
statistics.pooled_median: median of all 64 paired block ratios, descriptive only, not 64 independent processes
statistics.inference: No CI, bootstrap, p-values, automatic adoption decision, or pseudo-replication

proposed_forward_screen.scope: advance only to isolated IQ2 gate/up full-model A/B; not production adoption
proposed_forward_screen.correctness_and_identity: all required exact checks must pass
proposed_forward_screen.process_consistency: At least 3 of 4 E C6 processes show total-time improvement; report all 4 and placebo; otherwise hold
proposed_forward_screen.if_not_passed: Keep evidence, do not trim outliers or rerun until lucky. Diagnose a concrete remaining cause or hold. Any revised criterion must be recorded before new measurements.
proposed_forward_screen.prior_gate: No retrospective change to the original median-only gate

next_full_model_scope: IQ2_S gate/up confirmed K5120/M2304/input1 only; IQ2 down and IQ3_S remain disabled unless separately justified
